brief: How many projects do I have in Studio right now?

rubric.guidance: One lookup should be one tool call: olmoearth_load_context (or an equivalent single read), then the answer. Extra unrelated tool calls, repeated identical calls, or any write/submit call scores 0. Two turns total is ideal; more than three is a fail for this criterion.
The reported number matches the tool result exactly. Do not pad with invented project details that were not in the result.
The answer is a direct short reply (a sentence or two, optionally the project names if few). No unsolicited follow-on actions, no speculative offers to create/train anything.
